summary: [Shopify] webhooks: Verify HMAC on EVERY request: X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 = HMAC-SHA256(base64) over the RAW unparsed body with the correct secret; timing-safe comparison (length-check first). Respond 200 fast, process async (queue). Retries on timeout -> duplicates normal: handlers idempotent by topic+id. Do not poll what webhooks cover: polling is how you hit rate limits.
